fit_note: Foundation-agent report: real-device runtime, GUI+CLI batched actions, agent-driven data flywheel and long-horizon online RL bundled.
Slow planner precompiles a flat conditional policy tree; a fast observer routes branches to remove decode latency.
Single-step on-policy distillation from domain teachers, token-weighted by rule-checked action correctness; not GRPO but same shape.
Offline step-level GRPO on mined failure-critical states with a polarized rule reward against verified target actions.
Foundation CUA report: verifiable-task synthesis, rollout fleet, SFT with filtered reasoning and trajectory-sliced outcome RL bundled.
Post-hoc debugger inspects before/after screenshots to localise the root-cause step and feeds the diagnosis to re-execution.
VLM-selected coarse-to-fine crops with coordinate references and verification; training-free zoom-and-reground for high-res grounding.
Retrieved episodic trajectories and working-memory chunks compressed into gated, state-conditioned latent tokens for a frozen policy.
Trained standalone reflector checks before/after screenshots against generated conditions and feeds negative verdicts back.
Deterministically compiles passive human screen-activity capture into agent memory and replayable routines; no video mining or agent training.
